header.running_head: 3. The Rights and Duties of Muslims

blocks.arabic_text: الْحُبُّ فِي اللهِ وَالْبُغْضُ فِي اللهِ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه ابوداؤد باب مجانبة اهل الاهواء وبغضهم رقم:٤٥٩٩
blocks.tamil_translation: Hazrat Abu Dharr (RA) narrates that Rasulullah ﷺ said: “The best of deeds is to love for the sake of Allah Ta'ala and to hate for the sake of Allah Ta'ala.”

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ اَنَسٍ ﵁ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ: مَا مِنْ عَبْدٍ اَتَي اَخَاهُ يَزُوْرُهُ فِي اللهِ اِلَّا نَادَاهُ مَلَكٌ مِنَ السَّمَاءِ: اَنْ طِبْتَ، وَطَابَتْ لَكَ الْجَنَّةُ، وَاِلَّا قَالَ اللهُ فِيْ مَلَكُوْتِ عَرْشِهِ: عَبْدِيْ زَارَ فِيَّ، وَعَلَيَّ قِرَاهُ، فَلَمْ يَرْضَ لَهُ بِثَوَابٍ دُوْنَ الْجَنَّةِ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: (الحديث) رواه البزار وابو يعلي باسناد جيد الترغيب: ٣ /٣٦٤
blocks.tamil_translation: Hazrat Anas (RA) narrates that Rasulullah ﷺ said: “If any servant goes to visit his (Muslim) brother for the pleasure of Allah Ta'ala, an angel from the sky calls out to him and says, “May you live happily; for you there is a joyful Jannah.” And Allah Ta'ala says to the angels of the Arsh, “My servant has visited for My sake. Hosting him is My responsibility.” Allah Ta'ala will not give him any reward less than Jannah.”

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ زَيْدِ بْنِ اَرْقَمَ ﵁ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ: اِذَا وَعَدَ الرَّجُلُ اَخَاهُ وَمِنْ نِيَّتِهِ اَنْ يَفِيَ فَلَمْ يَفِ وَلَمْ يَجِيءْ لِلْمِيْعَادِ فَلَا اِثْمَ عَلَيْهِ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه ابوداؤد باب فِي العدة رقم:٤٩٩٥
blocks.tamil_translation: “If a person makes a promise to his brother and has the intention of fulfilling it, but he is unable to fulfil it, and is unable to come at the promised time, there is no blame on him.” Rasulullah ﷺ
